document: Increase minimum and maximum sentences for child sexual offences, We want the Government to reform minimum and maximum sentences for child sexual offences, so that anyone found guilty of a child sexual offences serves time in prison. We believe too many offenders are given suspended sentences and walk free while their victims suffer for the rest of their lives., I feel very strongly that penalties for child sexual offenders need to increase. Children who are the victims of child sexual offences have to deal with the abuse they experienced for the rest of their lives. Why should predators get away with ruining somebody's life?

Write off student loans for NHS and state school staff after five years, To encourage more health and educational workers to train we want the Government to write off student loans for NHS and state schools staff after five years. Interest on student loans should be frozen while they are working for the NHS or a state school., If the debt is written off, these workers could benefit from not having to pay back over £50,000. This would be a particularly valuable benefit in a time where the Government are not able to raise wages due to the economic climate. It would reward the professionals who help the system and hopefully help prevent too many people going to the private sector too quickly.

Change the way Suspended Sentences are given to convicted child abusers., Legally STOP handing out Suspended Sentences to CONVICTED paedophiles, this is to protect the children online. you would not allow a serial killer to be on a suspended sentence so why should the people who murder our children's souls and affect their lives be allowed freedom, Children are affected DAILY by online groomers and those who identify as "Minor Attracted People" (MAP's), it is my belief that IF these people COMMIT THE CRIME and are CONVICTED of it in a court of law then they should receive a CUSTODIAL Sentence WITHOUT THE CHANCE of a Suspended Sentence, if you wouldn't allow a serial killer to walk free on a Suspended sentence after conviction, why should a child abuser? are children's lives LESS important then the CONVICTED abusers?

Abolish planned accomodation for 1100 single male asylum seekers in HU16, To stop the housing of 1100 male asylum seekers in the village of Cottingham. We are a small village that is over populated already. There is a nearby school., Stop the housing of more asylum seekers in Cottingham. We do not have the facilities to house more single males to the area.

Ban convicted child sex offenders from living near schools and playgrounds, Too many convicted child sex offenders live in close proximity to schools and playgrounds. We believe this poses risks for children, and could increase the chance of reoffending. The Government should automatically ban convicted child sex offenders from living near schools and playgrounds.,

Add environmental damage as a public interest intervention ground for mergers, The Government must show a willingness and have the legal capability to intervene in mergers which would damage the environment. Competition legislation is a proven vehicle to drive social change and influence corporate decision making. Section 58 of the Enterprise Act should be amended to do this., The climate crisis is something which affects all of us. Amending competition legislation to ensure the Government can intervene to prevent mergers that would be to the detriment of the environment is important. We believe COP26 will not result in sufficient action to protect the environment, and the Government must take more robust strives towards mitigating the environment through frameworks such as competition law.

Increase the money children on free school meals receive to buy their meals, We want the Government to increase the £2.41 students on free school meals receive to buy their meals. Not everyone can afford to top these payments up, and too many children end up going hungry, which can impact their studies and behaviour., In some schools £2.41 isn't even enough to buy a sandwich and a drink

Make impersonating military personnel a specific criminal offence, We want the Government to put in place legislation to create a new specific offence of impersonating military personnel in order to deceive and/or defraud for personal gain., ‘Stolen Valour’ is the term commonly applied to individuals wearing military medals or decorations that they have not been awarded, with the intent to deceive or defraud.
 
This behaviour has a damaging effect on true veterans who 1) may find themselves under unfair/intense scrutiny and 2) cause a backlash against our heroic military personnel veterans & serving members alike.

Ban certain sexual offenders from prison visitor areas when under 18s present, Inmates who have been convicted of serious sexual offenses against children, or rape, should not be in the same room as children visiting those convicted of other crimes. How can you allow these children to sit in the same visiting room as convicted child sex offenders. Something needs to be done. , I believe it is unfair on those with children serving sentences for far less serious crimes (E.g. Fraud, Petty theft) to have to sit and visit their young family members when a convicted child sex offender can be sat on the table beside them. Those convicted of child sex offenses should have their own days/hours for visiting and shouldn’t be in the same room as anyone under 18.

Make training about online sexual abuse mandatory for teachers, We want the Government to require new training for teachers so they:
1. Understand the definitions of online sexual abuse
2. Can identify signs of peer-on-peer sexual abuse
3. Know how to respond to sexual harassment and online sexual abuse
4. Understand the potential dangers of social media, We know that sexual abuse online is a huge issue among teenage students. A 2021 review by Ofsted found that nearly 90% of girls, and nearly 50% of boys, said being sent explicit pictures or videos of things they did not want to see happens a lot or sometimes to them or their peers. Over half of the girls who responded to a questionnaire by Ofsted also said that pictures or videos of themselves that they did not know about were circulated sometimes or a lot. Too many teachers aren't educated enough about social media to identify and tackle this behaviour.

Restore the death penalty for serious offences, We demand that the UK Government restore capital punishment to the statute books for those convicted of murder, child sexual abuse, and drug & human trafficking. Because of the lives they destroy., We believe the levels of heinous murders, and cases of sexual abuse of children have exploded in recent years, that prison does not work and is not Justice. Family and friends can experience distress, knowing that the people convicted of crimes against their loved ones are alive in prison, and at the tax payers expense. We believe capital punishment would deliver justice for victims and their families. Whose rights do you value more, perpetrator or victim?

Increase student Maintenance Loans in England to close £1,500 inflation gap, Maintenance (living cost) Loans in England are set to rise by just 2.8% this year. Along with recent forecasting errors, students will be £1,500 poorer than if loans matched inflation. Loans must increase by more to avoid embedding this shortfall into the system – a financial disaster for students., At Save the Student, our 2022 Student Money Survey found that on average, living costs exceed loans by £439/MONTH (+£99 on 2021, +£216 on 2020).

This is mostly due to forecasting errors, with actual inflation rates exceeding predictions.

According to the IFS, 2.8% may be accurate for 2023/24 but doesn't fix 2 years of errors, leaving students £1,500/year worse off in real terms.

Unless this gap closes, students and parents will face extreme financial pressure, with many forced to drop out.

Hold a referendum on leaving the European Convention on Human Rights, I would like there to be a yes/no vote on leaving the ECHR, as there was with regards to leaving the European Union in 2016., Set up a free vote for everyone on the electoral register so that we all have a say in whether the UK continues to be a party to the ECHR.

Automatically remove domestic abusers from joint council tenancies, In cases where a joint tenant has been found guilty of domestic abuse they should be immediately and automatically removed from joint council tenancy agreements, where these were shared with the victim, to give the victim sole tenancy., Currently domestic abusers can be left on joint council tenancy agreements even after being found guilty of domestic abuse. We want this changed so that victims of domestic abuse are protected and their abusers do not have any rights to access the victim's home.

Automatic ban on child sexual offenders using internet services, The courts can limit how convicted child sexual offenders can use the internet, but we want an automatic ban on all child sexual offenders using internet services, including social media. We believe this would help protect children, who are increasingly online.,

Introduce Sharia Compliant Student Loans, We want the Government to introduce a Sharia Compliant Student Loan, as many Muslim students do not use the current student loan scheme, due to the fact that their religion prevents them from paying interest.,

More sentence time towards pedophiles., I want to be recognised that the justice system is corrupt. Sex offenders and pedophiles get months in prisons for traumatising a life and making life changing trauma to the people they have hurt. A sex offender/pedophile get months in prisons and it’s not ok., I want parliament and the government to act upon this because a drug dealer will get 15+ years in prison but a sex offender/pedophile will get a couple of months to two years in prison then get realised back into the public for “good behaviour”. It needs to be understood that this can cause a person to have life long trauma and hurt and it isn’t ok. Bring in more and longer sentences for these people. More protection needs to be provided for the people that are at risk of SE for older and younger.

Deny Sex Offenders the right to apply for removal from the Sex Offender Register, It’s horrifying that convicted sex offenders who were sentenced to more than 30 months for sexual offences and added to the Sex Offenders Register indefinitely can apply to be removed after 15 years. I want the right to apply for removal from the Sex Offenders Register to be removed., As a victim of sustained and severe sexual abuse at aged just 4 to the age of 16 by a number of men I feel like any justice dealt to these predators is completely eradicated when they are allowed to apply to be removed from the Sex Offenders Register.
 
It feels like my efforts in the interview rooms, court rooms and numerous therapists offices are in vain when these offenders can apply to be removed from this register after a time. Where is my safety and security? We believe these arrangements are a disgraceful betrayal to survivors.

Stop Halton Borough Council from scrapping free school meals service., I would like the government to force Halton Borough Council to do a U Turn on scrapping free school meal services. Potentially give Halton Borough Council increased funding solely for free school meals., School children are some of our most vulnerable people in society and children should not go without food due to the councils mis management of its finances.

Do not treat student maintenance loans as an income for Universal Credit, I want the Government to stop student maintenance loans being treated as income for Universal Credit. As a student nurse I am trying to better myself and follow my dreams, and it is not fair that student loans are treated as income for Universal Credit, when these most also be repaid., I feel that if this was scrapped that more people would sign up to university and become students. This would help students to feel less stressed and worried about money so they can better focus on their studies. I have spoken to a lot of students and they agree it is wrong to be effectively paying student loans twice.

To increase the minimum sentence for online grooming to ‘two years in prison’., Change the sentencing guidelines for, ‘sexual communication with a child’ from a community order to a minimum of two years in prison., The rates of reoffending of defendants that receive non-custodial sentences for this crime warrants it. 

To act as an effective deterrent to any individual considering committing this crime.

Increase funding for free school meals and issue meal vouchers during holidays, We want the Government to increase funding for free school meals, to increase the money children on free school meals receive to buy their meals, and the quality of the meals they receive. We also want the Government to fund meal vouchers for children receiving free school meals for the holidays.
, There are issues over the lack of money to buy adequate food, food that is not good quality for a young person relying on that meal and a need for vouchers in the holiday. It is clear there needs to be some Government action to improve meals and support for families in this cost of living crisis.

Don't stop the Danter fair in Weymouth Dorset, Help us keep the only fair we have that comes to our town..we are a seaside resort and hotel owners moan.. the fair shuts at 10 and when they leave they leave no mess.. They bring money to the town and something for kids to do of a evening.. we have nothing otherwise to keep youngsters occupied, Help us keep the fair or help us find somewhere down here to relocate it because none of the locals want it gone it wasn't put to the town for a vote abokt 10 people wanted this on weymouth Council but we as a town we want the fair

Revoke the right for pedophiles and sex offenders to change their name, I want pedophiles and sex offenders to no longer be able to change their names as it gives them access to new life’s without a criminal background which lets them directly back into schools and care homes for them to re-offend, Because it is disgusting that they are allowed brand new lives when other non-violent criminals have to be judged their entire lives

Life sentence for abuse, torture, rape or allowing the death of a child, Make the minimum sentence for anyone who abuses, tortures, rapes or allows the death of a child a life sentence!, We believe sentences for these horrific crimes are often far too lenient! It's disgusting that these evil people can get off so lightly for heinous crimes! There must be justice for what children have endured at the hands of these monsters! We believe people guilty of these offences deserve life imprisonment and no less.

Make the penalties for false accusation of rape the same as for rape, I would like the Government to make sentences for people who are found guilty of making false accusations of rape the same as for those who have been found guilty of rape., False accusations of rape can have horrendous consequences for the accused. Even if proven innocent the side effects can still affect the accused's life and if incorrectly found guilty could see them facing life in prison.

Where it has been proven that someone has falsely accused someone of rape, we believe they should face the same penalties as someone found guilty of rape.

Provide more funding to organisations helping to save orangutans and their homes, I would like the Government to provide more funding to organisations both in the UK and internationally to help them save Orangutans and their natural habitat. Helping organisations that help orangutans could also help other animals that live in the same jungles., I want to speak out for orangutans. Monkeys and apes are my favourite animals. Orangutans are critically endangered, and there are organisations that are trying to help. Some of these are The Borneo Orangutan Survival Foundation, The WWF and Chester Zoo. We want the Government to increase funding for organisations like this, to help save the orangutans.

Conduct a full review of the Child Maintenance Service, We want the Government to conduct an in-depth review of the Child Maintenance Service, to:, - identify and eliminate loopholes used by non-paying parents
- look at how victims of domestic abuse are protected
- identify past failures and put in place measures to prevent these in the future
 
I believe that the Child Maintenance Service does not currently ensure that parents who should be paying child maintenance do so, or have sufficient measures in place to protect the wellbeing of victims of domestic abuse, especially where they have been victims of financial abuse and coercive control, and are trying to gain financial independence.

Public Inquiry into Child Maintenance Service assessments and enforcement, We are concerned that incorrect assessments and inflation of amounts owed by paying parents, combined with excessive use of enforcement action, has caused significant distress to many paying parents, leading in some cases to catastrophic consequences., We, therefore, require the Government to launch a Public Inquiry to investigate how Child Maintenance Service maintenance assessments have been conducted, the validity of the £3.8 billion of arrears, the enforcement action taken by the Child Maintenance Service to collect arrears, and the impact this has had on paying parents.

Withdraw the 'Stop the Boats' - Illegal Migration Bill - from Parliament., Government should cease its attempt to extinguish the right to seek refugee protection in the UK for those who arrive irregularly. Seeking asylum is not a crime. Most people fleeing war and persecution are forced into taking dangerous journeys because there are no safe and legal routes left to them, The UNHCR has stated that it is "profoundly concerned" by the Government's proposed Illegal Migration Bill, and that it would amount to an effective asylum ban if passed. 

The effect of the legislation would be to deny protection to many asylum-seekers in need of safety and protection, and deny them the opportunity to put forward their case. This would be a clear breach of the Refugee Convention and would undermine a longstanding, humanitarian tradition of which the British people are proud.

Provide compensation for incorrect child maintenance assessments, Many Paying Parents have had incorrect assessments for child maintenance. This has been followed by wrongful enforcement that has caused financial loss and impacted mental health. We want compensation for people affected by incorrect child maintenance assessments and wrongful enforcement., We believe the Child Support Agency/Child Maintenance Service have been causing harm, loss, and damage by chasing PP's for money which has been incorrectly assessed and then using draconian enforcement to collect debts that are not actually owed. In some cases Paying Parents have been made homeless and have been left in a vulnerable and disadvantaged position and suffering from poor mental health as a result of the wrongful enforcement. Compensation must be paid to the victims.

Require accommodation providers to disclose if they are housing asylum seekers, Make it mandatory for any accommodation provider housing asylum seekers that are awaiting approval to stay in the UK that they must inform any customers booking accommodation with them of this at the point of booking., We believe that customers have a right to know if they will be staying at accommodation that is also being used to house asylum seekers, especially as many have arrived in this country through unauthorised routes, and are unvetted and undocumented.

Hold a referendum on how many asylum seekers the UK accepts, We believe many claims for asylum are 'bogus', and want the Government to give us the right to vote on how many asylum seekers the UK accepts. Give us a chance to voice our opinions.,

Non-payment of child maintenance a criminal offence with custodial penalties, To make non-payment of child maintenance a criminal offence, with custodial penalties for offenders., We believe current rules for non-payment of child maintenance do not hold non-paying parents fully responsible for their actions.
 
I believe that the Child Maintenance Service are failing parents who are not receiving the child maintenance they are due. Non-paying parents owe millions of pounds.
 
If a receiving parent can't afford to provide for their child they could face charges of neglect. Non-paying parents should face criminal penalties for failing to support their child, as this is also neglecting the child.
 
By making non-payment a criminal offence the police could take action against non-paying parents, hopefully helping ensure child maintenance is paid.

Give schools access to names and photographs of registered sex offenders, I want the Government to ensure that schools have access to the names and photographs of everyone who is a registered sex offenders., This could schools ensure that they protect their students from registered sex offenders, and hopefully help prevent future offences.

Invoke Article 13 of the North Atlantic Treaty to withdraw the UK from (NATO)., The UK was a founding member of NATO, which was established to address a perceived threat from the Soviet Union. But the USSR dissolved in 1991, so NATO’s initial reason to exist disappeared. But rather than winding up its operations NATO nearly doubled the number of member states., Since 1991, NATO, which claims to be a defensive military alliance, has been directly engaged in various offensive military operations. I believe that the membership of NATO is now endangering UK citizens.

Urgently review the current Ofsted Framework and associated methodology, In light of recent events, and in meaningful consultation with the sector, review the Ofsted framework and methodology, which we believe are overly burdensome and do little to improve school performance. Government should urgently consider the impact of Ofsted on the wellbeing of education staff., The Ofsted framework and methodology must be reviewed so that inspection is a supportive tool that brings about meaningful change via a professional and respectful process.

Make Student Finance repayments tax deductible, A tax deduction for Student Finance repayments would ease graduates' financial burden. High-interest rates and long repayment periods make it harder than ever to live. Deducting repayments from taxable income would reduce yearly amounts owed, providing immediate relief and simplifying repayment., For example, a recent graduate earns £30k annually with a student loan balance of £50k at 5.4% interest rate. Presently, they must pay £243 p.a. (9% of income over £27,295). If student finance repayments were tax-deductible, they could deduct £243 from their taxable income, saving approximately £49 per year (20% basic tax rate).
 
Over 30 years, they would save around £1,500, which they could use for living expenses or savings, or to reduce their overall student loan balance.

Do not require domestic chicken owners to register their birds, The Government is consulting on proposals to require all poultry keepers to officially register their birds. We believe that imposing this requirement on domestic chicken owners is Government overreach, and should not happen., We want freedom from Government interference in our domestic lives.

Hotels must apply for planning permission to convert into Asylum hostels, Nobody is standing up for businesses and residents adversely effected by the conversion of hotels into hostels for Asylum seekers. 

It is not right that local businesses and residents are treated like second-class citizens in their own towns., Crawley in West Sussex use to benefit from tourists and travellers staying at a number or hotels in the town centre including the Ramada  and Arora Hotel. Over the past 12 months these hotels have been turned into asylum hostels without any public consultation or foresight from Crawley Borough Council. 

The loss of tourists and travellers is decimating local trade. Without change more business will fail and sow further discontent.

Require health professionals notify DVLA of all 'notifiable' medical conditions, This petition is calling on the Government to make it mandatory for all health professionals to report to the DVLA any drivers with health conditions that may affect their ability to drive safely., The Government should create legal obligations for medical professionals to inform the DVLA if a patient has been diagnosed with condition which could mean that they are unsafe to operate a vehicle.

Currently patients are advised to inform the DVLA and insurer themselves if they have a diagnosis. There are no safeguarding measures to ensure that this has been done.

The purpose of this petition is to help improve road safety.

Fund aftercare in sexual offence cases where there is no conviction, We want the Government to provide funding for aftercare/support/counselling for individuals and their families in cases where someone has been accused of sexual offences, but these have not been proven. Many people in this situation do not receive the support they need., When a person is accused of a sexual offences it affects the individual massively but also affects other members of their immediate family, both in the short and long term.
 
I feel if aftercare is given then the individuals can better go on to deal with the situation. I feel this should be offered to all individuals and their family in cases where no further action is taken, or there is an acquittal.

Mandatory custodial sentences for animal abuse offences, Increase deterrents for animal abuse by introducing harsher punishments. Prison sentences should be given for those found guilty of animal abuse. We believe fines are no deterrent., Too many people who are found guilty of animal abuse go on to reoffend. We believe harsher sentences would prevent this.

Abolish Section 13 of the Criminal Appeal Act 1995, Section 13 of the Criminal Appeal Act 1995 requires that the Criminal Cases Review Commission only refer cases if it believes that there is a “real possibility” the conviction will be quashed. This can leave innocent victims languishing in prison unable to overturn their convictions., The CCRC is not the panacea to the problem of the wrongful conviction of the innocent that was envisaged and hoped for. Section 13 of the Criminal Appeal Act 1995 structures reviews in such a way that it must reject applications of innocent victims of miscarriages of justice if it is not felt that they have the necessary new evidence or argument to satisfy the ‘real possibility’ test. It is wrong, inhumane and unacceptable that innocent victims are unable to overturn their wrongful convictions.

Require planning permission for hotels to be used as hostels for asylum seekers, We believe nobody is standing up for businesses and residents adversely effected by the use of hotels as hostels for asylum seekers. We think that the views of local businesses and residents are being disregarded., Crawley in West Sussex use to benefit from tourists and travellers staying at a number of hotels in the town centre including the Ramada and Arora Hotel. Over the past 18 months these hotels have been used as asylum hostels without any public consultation. The loss of tourists and travellers is detrimental to local trade, and without change we are concerned more business will fail and sow further discontent.

Speak to the owners of a local Alsatian dog who is known to be aggressive, We shouldn’t be scared to walk past our roads, at night or in the day, this dog has been known to chase children and tore up a young girls coat., It’s dangerous and it could end up with severe consequences- I.e dog attack. It’s not fair on the dog.

Referendum to close the Scottish Parliment, Facilitate a democratic referendum under the Scotland Act to give Scots a vote to close the Scottish Parliment or keep it open ., Ensure the petition is not blocked by political self interest political party or house of commons staff . The petition would simply allow  a decision. And a binary referendum would do the same . I am concerned you don't want the democratic question to be asked   ?

Stop the Old Northeye Prison from being used as a Asylum Seeker Camp, The Government need to change their plans on turning the Old Northeye Prison is Bexhill into a Centre for Asylum Seekers. The Government have stated that they propose to hold 1200 Adult Male Asylum Seekers in the new centre by December 2023., This is an area where there are many children and families who would be worried about 1200 men being right on their doorstep. The children play along the private road and disused car park and families will feel uncomfortable letting their children play outside and will take away the enjoyment to be outside.

Offer asylum to all LGBTQ+ Ugandans facing persecution in Uganda, To help LGBTQ+ Ugandans escape persecution in Uganda, offer asylum and help them travel to the UK., I fear for the safety of LGBTQ+ folk in Uganda who now face the death penalty or life in prison. They really need our help and any LGBTQ+ identity should be a valid reason for being granted asylum when you face capital punishment for something natural you cannot change about yourself.

Do Not Leave the European Convention on Human Rights, It has been reported that the Prime Minister is considering leaving the European Convention on Human Rights (ECHR) to support efforts to prevent people from seeking asylum. This decision could place the rights of the British people under serious threat. We want the UK to remain part of the ECHR., Leaving the ECHR would reduce the UK's international commitments in respect of human rights. We are concerned that this could lead to changes such as the rolling back of LGBTQ rights, more deportations, and even death sentences returning.
 
Human Rights legalisation is already a complex field, and we want the Government to commit to not leaving the ECHR, to ensure that the UK's international commitments in respect of human rights are not reduced.

Take the UK out of the European Convention on Human Rights, We believe it is necessary to take the UK out of the ECHR to take back full control of our borders, to that the UK can implement measures to prevent migrants entering the country illegally., It has been reported that suspected terrorists have entered the UK illegally from France but because they have the right to have a claim for asylum considered cannot be removed. We believe this is a national emergency. The Government must take all necessary action to protect the British people from the threat of terrorist acts. We believe this country is being made unsafe, and that the impact on our public services is enormous. Start putting law abiding citizens first.

Introduce new laws to force offenders to be present in court for sentencing, Families are currently being deprived the opportunity of gaining full closure because offenders can choose not to appear in court for sentencing., We want the law to require offenders to be in court for sentencing, to give victims and their families every chance to witness justice be delivered.
 
Following a number of high-profile cases where serious criminal offenders refused to be in the dock when their sentence is passed down, we are petitioning for a change in the law so they can be forced to appear.  
 
We want prison and court staff to be given powers to use reasonable force to get offenders into the dock - as they do to transfer them from a court to prison.

Repeal the Genetic Technology (Precision Breeding) Act 2023, Having repealed this act, if the Government wants to reintroduce it they should hold a public consultation & invite the public to have its say, since it directly relates to the way food is being produced.
 
, We believe it's democratic and right thing to do.
 
The Government should involve the public in matters that directly affect their health & wellbeing.
 
The Government should provide detailed information about any health implications/benefits that may result from the use of genetic technology, ahead of any future consultation or public vote.

Challenge the Local Authorities' policy on booking public buildings, Review access to public venues. Hampshire and Dorset have changed public hire rules, preventing local groups from returning to venues used before the pandemic., We have tried unsuccessfully to gain the interest of local councils - Winchester who have made some small concessions ignored 3 requests for e-Petitions and Bournemouth who have refused to meet and both have demonstrated intransigence in their responses.

Minimum 15-year sentence for all child sexual offences, I would like the Government to increase the minimum custodial sentence for any offenders found guilty of a sexual offence against minors to 15 years., We want there to be a 15-year minimum sentence for anyone committing a sexual offence against children, including grooming, sending and receiving indecent images/videos.

I believe this problem is the biggest facing this country, and that increasing sentences will help reduce crimes against children. Children's safety should be our number one priority. The Government must take action to protect them.

Stop housing asylum seekers in tourist towns, We want the Government to stop housing asylum seekers in tourist towns, eg. Skegness and Blackpool, We believe asylum seekers should be housed in cities, which are less reliant on tourism.
 
Towns such as Skegness, Blackpool and Cleethorpes all rely on tourists to keep the town booming. Currently much accommodation that would normally be available to tourists is taken up by asylum seekers. When a town relies on tourist income this is something that needs to be reconsidered.

5-year prison sentences and communications restrictions for child sex offenders, I want a minimum custodial sentence of at least 5 years for any sexual offence toward a child, with lifelong restrictions on communicating with children, and mandatory higher sentences for repeat offenders., I believe too many child sex offenders receive non-custodial sentences, and are not subject to restrictions that could help prevent reoffending.
 
I want stricter sentences to be set out in law, and mandatory lifelong restrictions on communicating with children, to help prevent reoffending.

UK government should provide Leave to Remain for asylum seekers from Sudan, Urgently ask the Home Office to immediately guarantee Leave to Remain for the Sudanese asylum seekers currently waiting for their asylum claims to be determined.
, There were 5,601 Sudanese nationals waiting for a decision as of March 2023. This number includes vulnerable groups, women, and children.

Amend the law on rape to cover all non-consensual penetration of vagina or anus, Change the Sexual Offences Act to include any penetration of the vagina or anus. Currently rape only covers using a penis without consent to penetrate the vagina, mouth, or anus of another person. This excludes other acts of penetration, and means women cannot be charged with rape., There is more than the weight of sentencing, there is the weight in public opinion of how serious a crime is.
 
We believe the current definition of rape discourages victims of other non-consensual penetration to come forward, because other sexual offences can be regarded as less serious. This can increase the fears victims have of not being taken seriously.

Remove the automatic exclusion policy for fostering/adopting, The current policy of automatically excluding someone from fostering or adopting a child if one of their family members has been convicted of a serious crime should be scrapped. We believe that the potential adopter or foster carer should not be judged by the actions of a convicted family member., Local authorities are closing application before they have fully assessed any risk to the child. If the conviction has passed and the family member has served their time, adopters and foster carers, should be allowed to get on with their lives without being impacted by the past actions of family members
 
There are children out there that need a place to call home and a supportive family. Automatic exclusions are stopping several people from fostering/adopting.

Transport regulation for private and Hackney set towns border, I would like to protect the taxi drivers from each city of uk by set border limits.
For example I live and work  in Merseyside like a private hire driver. Over here and not just here in Merseyside comes drivers from other towns working here. Please protect us and our family, The drivers want have licence from other towns crash our income, they haven't knowledge about town and we need this borders to be in place .

Allow all single-sex spaces to exclude people of the other biological sex, The Government should make it clear that all single-sex spaces can exclude people of the other biological sex without having to prove it is "a proportionate means of achieving a legitimate aim". There has been considerable social media coverage about biological men entering women-only spaces., I am a personal trainer and I am an advocate of women-only areas in gyms. Many women, such as those from certain faiths, don't wish to exercise before men. The Equality Act should be updated so that all woman-only spaces can exclude biological men.
 
I believe that allowing transgender people into such areas can make women uncomfortable and can expose the transgender person to physical and verbal abuse. It's protection for both sides.

Stop farmers from having the right to shoot dogs, Under the Animal Welfare Act 2006, it is an offence to cause unnecessary suffering to dogs. However, a farmer can shoot a dog if they believe the dog is about to cause harm to their livestock or has caused harm, and there is no other reasonable way to prevent this., Farmers harming dogs should not be an acceptable option. Currently, the law creates fear and worry in dog owners. There are currently hefty fines of up to £1,000 for the owners of dogs who have caused damage or harm to livestock. Please sign this petition to save future dogs from unnecessary deaths.

Seek a global moratorium on development of AI technology due to extinction risk, We welcome the recent recognition of existential risk from Artificial Intelligence by the Prime Minister. Further to this, we request that the Government seeks a global moratorium on further development of the technology until AI Safety/Alignment research catches up., Many believe that Artificial General Intelligence (AGI) is on the horizon. All that may be needed for it to happen is more compute and data (money) being thrown at it. Some experts have said that powerful AI systems are already uncontrollable (and only not a significant danger because they are relatively weak). Systems much more intelligent than humans may be built soon, and may be inherently uncontrollable. We need to pause development of these systems globally until there is a consensus on how to align them to humanity.

Write off student loans for university students graduating in 2023, Due to the terrible impact of Covid and the state of the economy over the last three years, we want the Government to write off student loans for all university students graduating this year. This is a simple process as Student Finance England has all the required information., The last three years in higher education, with many classes cancelled or online, and the great upheaval in their lives as a result of Covid have been a terrible time for the current cohort of students.
 
In addition the ongoing lecturers' strike and the non-marking of final papers, dissertations etc. means this cohort of students has not had the university experience they expected, and this could have a lasting impact on their future.
 
The least the Government can do is absolve them of the huge student debt they have amassed in this time.

Abandon plans to transfer asylum seekers to Rwanda., It's essential for the UK Government to acknowledge the inherent flaws and risks associated with this inhumane transfer. By ceasing this policy, the UK can demonstrate its commitment to human rights, international obligations, and the preservation of its moral standing as a compassionate nation., By transferring asylum seekers to Rwanda, the UK potentially violates its obligations under international law.  Multiple reputable organisations, including Amnesty International, Human Rights Watch, and the United Nations High Commissioner for Refugees (UNHCR), have expressed concerns over effective legal protection and access to fair asylum procedures in Rwanda.

Send all asylum seekers to a third country or their home country, We do not believe that the current policy of sending some asylum seekers to Rwanda goes far enough. We want the Government to send all asylum seekers to Rwanda or another third country, or return them to their home country, with no exceptions, and no asylum seekers to be allowed to stay in the UK., The unelected judiciary and Lords are frustrating the Government's attempts to tackle illegal migration into the UK, including by asylum seekers. We believe there are far too many asylum seekers in, and coming to, the UK, and we do not want them here.
 
We want all asylum seekers to be relocated to a third country, irrespective of where that is, or their home country.
 
The Government should withdraw from any international agreements, and pass legislation to prevent any legal challenges, that could prevent this policy.

make women responsible for committing an act of rape, Change the definition of rape in order to charge women of rape., In the eyes of the UK law , rape is only the penetration of the mouth , anus or vagina with a penis. I believe that women who have used things like sex toys, or any other object that resembles a penis or forces sex upon a man should be charged with rape. If a woman was to drug a man and have sex with his unconscious body, she would only be charged with sexual assult, whereas if it was a man in that situation he would be charged with rape.

Legally pardon those convicted in Great Britain for offences of witchcraft

, The Witchcraft Act 1735 repealed legislation creating offences for witchcraft, recognising that the belief that people could use demonic magic to harm and murder was not a reality. Even though this meant the people convicted and executed under former Acts had been innocent, they were never pardoned., Witch persecution is still happening. The UN passed a resolution in 2021 calling on countries to deal with the problem. In 2022, the First Minister of Scotland issued an apology to those convicted under the Scottish Witchcraft Act — the result of a petition to the Scottish Parliament (PE1855.) The Scottish Government failed to issue a pardon. Our silence and failure to pardon our own sends the wrong message that the British people condone the witch executions in Africa, Papua New Guinea and India.

Improve Mental Health Support in the Armed Forces, I am calling on the Government to improve mental health support for our British service personnel. Address stigma, allocate funding, enhance education, ensure timely access to services, foster stronger partnerships, and provide ongoing support., Let's prioritise the well-being of our personnel, both during and after their service. Collaboration with charities is valuable, but the military must take the lead. Together, we can create a comprehensive support system for our veterans.

Ensure sex workers are not excluded from banking services, The Government should review current laws to ensure that people who work in the sex industry can access banking services. , They are often refused bank accounts because of the nature of their jobs, even though it is completely legal and they pay tax. Sex workers also struggle with loans, mortgages etc.

I work in the sex industry and have been refused for 15 bank accounts because of the nature of my job even though it is completely legal and I am registered with HMRC. People should not be discriminated against because they work in the sex industry.

Introduce tax relief for service personnel on military pensions, I want the Government to exempt military pensions from income tax, for service personnel who have completed a full service or medically discharged and have completed at least one tour of duty., As an ex-forces soldier who is in receipt of an army pension after serving 22 years, I am working in an ordinary job but but my army pension puts me into the higher tax bracket. This is wrong in my opinion. British service personnel put their lives on the line, and this should be recognised in tax arrangements for military pensions.

Require jurors in rape trials to complete mandatory training on rape myths, Research shows that many jurors accept widely held false beliefs about rape, rapists and victims. , These 'rape myths' can influence decision making in trials. To give victims a fair chance at obtaining justice we want jurors to complete mandatory training on rape myths prior to sitting on rape trials. 

Currently, less than 1% of reported rapes leads to a conviction. And the police and CPS rarely put forward cases they think won't convince a jury; while police recorded 67,125 rapes in 2021 only 1,557 of these were sent to trial.

As studies show that jurors who accept rape myths are more likely to issue not guilty verdicts, dispelling rape myths in juries is key to ensuring fair trials and improving low conviction rates.

Restore COVID-19 wastewater monitoring in England
, Wastewater testing for SARS-Cov-19 (COVID-19) virus, authorised by the government and implemented by the Joint Biosecurity Centre, Defra and the Environment Agency, that had provided an early warning system for virus spread, has ended in England. It continues in Wales and needs to resume in England., When ending the COVID-19 global health emergency, the World Health Organisation made clear that COVID-19 remains a global health threat. It warned against complacency and reduced surveillance. WHO director general Dr Ghebreyesus said: “The worst thing any country could do now is to use this news as a reason to let down its guard, to dismantle the systems it has built, or to send the message to its people that COVID-19 is nothing to worry about.” The UK has done just that, risking public health.

Prohibit questions in court about the sexual history of rape complainants, Section 41 of the Youth Justice and Criminal Evidence Act 1999 bans questions about sexual behaviour of complainants, but courts can allow such questions in certain circumstances. For rape cases, we only want questions about sexual relations between the complainant and defendant to be permissible., We believe this legislation is being interpreted and applied inconsistently, and that courts should not be able to permit questions about sexual behaviour of complainants, with the exception of those with the accused. What the complainant did in the past has no relevance to the defence case of the accused.
By amending Section 41 all complainants in rape cases would be treated in the same way and would not have to fear being humiliated in court about something they may or may not have done in the past. This may encourage more complainants to engage with the court system.

Sex offenders to be subject to approval by communities before being housed, Government must put in place community awareness and approval BEFORE a registered sex offender is housed within the area., Child sex abuse and grooming won't be tolerated in N.Ireland. The laws must change to allow parents/guardians to be aware that a sex offender is applying to move into their communities, allowing them the options to accept or decline sex offender/s to be housed there. This is to further safe guard children.

Urge the Indian government to better protect its Christian population, We want the Government of the United Kingdom to urge the Indian Government to do more to protect its persecuted Christian population. We must speak out for our human right to worship in freedom., Christians have been killed, degraded, raped and murdered in India. We believe that if the world authorities speak up, it could put an end to this.

Fast-track the Renters (Reform) Bill, We call upon the Government to fast-track the Renters (Reform) Bill and pass it by Autumn 2023. Parliament should allow time for this Bill to be prioritised to protect renters from no fault evictions., It has been reported that there could be an unprecedented amount of "no fault" evictions because the Government has introduced the Renters (Reform) Bill. Indeed, it is estimated that it could involve an eviction every 15 minutes. We believe that in these exceptional circumstances, Parliament should prioritise this Bill and allow it to become law by Autumn 2023. The Bill also should be amended so that it applies to all section 21 notices which have been issued but not executed at the time when the Bill is passed and becomes law."

Give British people priority need for accommodation, The Government should include British Citizens in the list for priority need for accommodation within the Housing Act 1996. , We have a government who constantly find homes for thousands of Asylum Seekers, yet they appear to lack the same urgency for our own citizens. Those who have paid taxes and helped to build our Nation deserve to be housed first and foremost.
 
We must start to treat our citizens with the same respect and dignity that we give others.

House all asylum seekers who entered the UK illegally in basic accommodation, We want the Government to house asylum seekers who entered the UK illegally in basic accommodation that caters to their basic needs - shelter, food, clothing, hygiene - until the Government is able to design and implement realistic plan of relocating and removing them from the country permanently., We believe the country has been inundated by people who have entered the UK illegally. Given the number of safe countries many of these individuals travel through in order to reach the UK, we also believe many are economic migrants, and not genuine refugees.
 
We are sick of the current situation, and platitudes from the Government. These people should be placed in basic accommodation, not hotels, until a solution can be reached for relocation.

Free court transcripts for survivors of sexual offences and domestic violence, Survivors of sexual offences and domestic violence are being faced with staggering bills to get access to court hearing transcripts. We believe this is a deeply troubling practice that has a significant impact on victims., The First Minister of Scotland announced a pilot scheme that provides free access to court transcripts for survivors of sexual offences. We firmly believe that England should follow suit.

Accessibility to court transcripts allows victims to bring to attention statements made during legal proceedings, and better comprehend the judgements passed. It is also an integral aspect of maintaining transparency and accountability within the legal system.

Let everyone access the sex offenders register,  I want the sex offenders register to be open to all UK residents. They should be able to see details of offenders in their area. People have a right to know who they are living near to. 
, I think everyone, especially parents, should be allowed to access the sex offenders register. Many people may have bought a house and then, once settled, discover they are next door to a sex offender, or that sex offenders are housed near their children's schools etc. We all have a right to know where these offenders live so we can protect our children.

Make dangerous dog act about creating positive change not killing innocent dogs, Discuss the solution to the dangerous dog act.
The attacks are not caused by dogs, it’s because we sit & watch as they are over bred, hyped all across social media, shipped & sold for money. Whist some are neglected & abandoned
It’s time we stop passing blame to innocent animal & create a solution, There are solutions
- Owners need licence to have a dog 
- No unlicensed breeding. No selling/buying online (actually regulate this)
- Actual punishments for animal abuse/neglect to be implement and tightened 
- Animal welfare education in our schools, so the next generation doesn’t repeat this

With all due respect the attacks are not on the dogs, they are on the people in power ignoring the problems. 

We are better than this. Let’s come together and create a world without suffering together

Fund more police and require shops to have a safe space
, The Government should fund more police to patrol areas and should require shops to have a safe space for individuals to go if they feel unsafe., We need more police in town at all times. We need to know that if something is to happen then there is someone there to make us feel safe. All shops need to have a safe place we can go to if something were to happen, we can’t eliminate bullying and abuse completely so we can put scheme in place so we can always get to somewhere safe.

Make it illegal for people over 21 to have sexual intercourse with under 18s, Create a law so young people are protected from predatory adults over the age of 21 taking advantage of a power imbalance.
, We believe that more needs to be done to recognise in law the vulnerability of those who are of the age of consent but are still very young, from sexual exploitation. It is our view that there is no scenario where it is acceptable for a grown adult to be in a sexual relationship with a school child who cannot vote in some elections and, in many cases, can't take out a loan, or rent a property.

Hold a public referendum on whether to sign the WHO pandemic treaty, We think the government should hold a public referendum to allow us to vote on whether to sign the WHO pandemic treaty. We do not think that this is a decision for the government to make without public input., We believe that the WHO pandemic treaty is a dangerous threat to our sovereignty.
Pass a law to stop standing charges on domestic bills, Stop standing charges on domestic bills, so that you only have to pay for actual usage.,

Fund an awareness campaign and more support for male domestic abuse victims, Increase funding for services dedicated to men for the help and support they need to get protection and help with domestic abuse., We don't think there is enough awareness about the issue. We also don't think there are enough services dedicated to help and support men going through domestic violence. Men can find it shameful and embarrassing seeking help and there needs to be more help out there for them to protect them.

Repeal the Online Safety Act and hold a comprehensive public consultation, We want the Government to repeal the Online Safety Act and hold a comprehensive consultation with the people to ensure that consent of the public is present., We want the Government to engage in a full consultation process with the public. This should include information leaflets to all people and public meetings where people are fully informed about what the Act contains and the consequences.
 
There seems to have been little engagement with the people about this Act, a lot has been talked about in the media, but we believe a full consultation needs to be held.

Make non-payment of child maintenance a criminal offence, We want the Government to make non-payment of child maintenance a criminal offence, so that parents who withhold child maintenance when they have the means and capacity to pay can be pursued through the criminal justice system. We believe this would help prevent non-payment., Withholding child maintenance from the parent who ensures all the child/children's needs are met should be made a criminal offence akin to child neglect /abuse. Pursuing non-payment of child maintenance through the Child Maintenance Service and courts can take months of even years for payment to be enforced. We believe that this is not acceptable, and that making non-payment of child maintenance a criminal offence could help prevent non-payment.

Public Inquiry into the Child Maintenance Service, We are concerned that incorrect assessments and inflation of amounts owed by paying parents, combined with excessive use of enforcement action, has caused significant distress to many paying parents, leading in some cases to catastrophic consequences. We want a Public Inquiry to investigate this., We want the Government to launch a Public Inquiry to investigate how Child Maintenance Service maintenance assessments have been conducted, the validity of the £3.8 billion of arrears, the enforcement action taken by the Child Maintenance Service to collect arrears, and the impact this has had on paying parents.

Public Inquiry into Child Maintenance Service assessments and enforcement, We are concerned that incorrect assessments and inflation of amounts owed by paying parents, combined with excessive use of enforcement action, has caused significant distress to many paying parents, leading in some cases to catastrophic consequences., We, therefore, require the Government to launch a Public Inquiry to investigate how Child Maintenance Service maintenance assessments have been conducted, the validity of the £3.8 billion of arrears, the enforcement action taken by the Child Maintenance Service to collect arrears, and the impact this has had on paying parents.

Treat Serious Youth Violence as a public health issue, The Government needs to treat Serious Youth Violence (SYV) as a pressing public health issue and take proactive measures to address its root causes.  SYV poses a significant threat to public safety, and it demands a comprehensive, multi-faceted approach that goes beyond law enforcement., Adopting a public health approach to tackle SYV, particularly knife crime,  is essential.  It would focus on prevention, intervention, and support, addressing the social determinants contributing to the problem.  By treating SYV as a public health issue, we can work toward:

•	Early intervention
•	Community-based solutions 
•	Mental health and trauma support
•	Education and awareness
•	Research and data collection
•	Collaboration
•	The creation of safer and healthier communities

Remove parental responsibility from child sexual offenders and child abusers, We would like to petition for parental responsibility to be automatically taken away from a convicted child abuser and/or child sexual offender immediately after being found guilty, whether it be their own children or children from another family., The Government has committed to passing Jade's Law, so parents who kill a partner or ex-partner with whom they have children will automatically have their parental responsibility suspended upon sentencing. We would like to this to be extended to people guilty of child sexual offences or child abuse, to prevent offenders exercising parental rights either from jail or after release.
 
We believe the safety of all our children in the United Kingdom should be safe guarded by law from the moment offenders are found guilty,
Move the British Embassy to Jerusalem, Move the British Embassy to Jerusalem., The capital city of Israel is Jerusalem. It's time for the government to acknowledge this fact.

Review the MOD's New Accommodation Offer for armed forces personnel, Review the proposed New Accommodation Offer which is due for implementation in March 2024. Undertake further engagement with affected personnel to shape the policy before its execution.
 
, At present, the New Accommodation Offer has been poorly received by a number of service personnel who will be affected. If the policy is implemented as it currently stands, we believe that armed forces retention rates are likely to fall to even lower levels than those at present. This could have an irreversible effect on the capability of the armed forces over both the immediate and intermediate term.

Fund more training for public sector workers on domestic violence, Fund additional training on domestic violence for teachers, social services, police and medical professionals to help cases be identified and dealt with more effectively and efficiently., The number of cases of domestic abuse of children to adults is rising in the UK and we believe the systems in place victims are failing.  Many victims don't have enough support and resources available to them.
 
I think increasing funding for training of public sector workers on domestic abuse would help these workers to identify victims, and could help prevent homelessness as a result of domestic violence.

Require judges to continue to jail rapists that are found guilty, Judges are being told not to jail rapists due to prisons being full, so violent offenders are allowed to wander the streets and put the general public in danger. Why not less violent offenders, such as personal drug users, or other crimes that don't put people in danger of life changing violence?,

Require police to have training on domestic abuse/post-separation control, Implement a law so that all serving police officers are required to have mandatory domestic abuse and post-separation control training. I am concerned that currently, too many domestic abuse victims are left to suffer and domestic abusers walk around freely., I'm concerned that too many victims are told by the police that they do not have enough evidence or their abusers' behaviour doesn't constitute an offence. I believe that mandatory training could help the police take reports of domestic abuse and related offences more seriously.

Mandatory life sentence for child sexual offenders, I believe that people who have committed child sexual offences should receive mandatory life sentences and never be released from prison., No matter the offence committed, we want all child sexual offenders to serve live in prison, to ensure they cannot commit another offence.

Create a public register of people awaiting trial for sexual offences, Create a Law where an offender awaiting trial for a sexual offence against a victim is put on public register, so new potential partners/workplaces/etc can check if someone is awaiting trial for a sexual offence., Sexual offence cases can take years to go to trial, with defendants often released on bail with no or limited conditions. A public register of people awaiting trial for sexual offences would mean that people could find out if someone was suspected of a sexual offence, and potentially avoid becoming a victim themselves.

Review how Home Office deals with applications for ILR due to domestic violence, People can apply for indefinite leave to remain (ILR) because of a relationship breakdown due to domestic violence or abuse, if their partner was a British citizen or settled in the UK. We are concerned that people could be making false allegations of violence or abuse to seek ILR. , We want the Government to undertake a review into how such applications are considered by the Home Office to ensure they are being thoroughly investigated.

Ban those with any ties to terrorist organisations organising protests, The Government should ban, under the Terrorism Act, anyone with current or previous ties to terrorist organisation from organising, or helping to organise through any third party, events that are associated in any way with protest events.,

Increase investment in flood risk management and climate resilience
 
, The UK is at high risk from the impacts of climate change. While climate change is politicised, and many find the topic overwhelming, we must understand and prepare for its consequences: floods, droughts and sea levels rising to name a few., The UK needs to be better equipped for the increasing impacts of climate change on our country.
 
There have been several extreme weather events in recent years where climate change has been identified as a potential cause.
 
The Met Office has said it expects climate change to mean wetter winters, drier summers and more frequent and intense weather extremes, with associated floods and droughts.
 
We urgently need to increase UK funding around flood risk management and climate resilience before extreme events occur.
 
I am writing this petition because I care about our future. Do you?

Increase Student Loans in England to catch up with inflation, Over the past 2 years (Sept ‘21–‘23), inflation (RPIX) has been 21%. But max Student Loans in England rose by just 5.2%, leaving students up to £1,500/year worse off (real terms). The government must increase loans to catch up with inflation, or we fear many students won’t be able to survive at uni., We can all agree that students should have enough money to eat.

But at Save the Student, our 2023 Money Survey found that, on average, living costs now exceed loans by £582/month.

And despite other parts of the UK increasing loans by between 9.4% – 40% this year to help students with living costs, loans in England rose by just 2.8%.

As a result, 18% of students we surveyed told us they used a food bank in 2022/23, and 64% said they skipped meals at least some of the time.

Loans simply must catch up with inflation to avoid further suffering.

Require Student Loans Company to automatically refund overpayments, The Government should require the SLC to issue refunds automatically for all unintentional overpayments, similar to tax, without the payer having to request it. , Many people in the UK have been unintentionally overpaying their student loan amounts. We believe that the SLC have not been sufficiently proactive in returning overpayments, nor appropriately responsive when they have been contacted by the customer.
 
We believe this approach is unethical and should be challenged.

Don't axe shorter prison sentences for crimes such as stalking and harassment, The University of Birmingham's Intersectional Feminist Association calls on the Government to amend plans for a legal presumption against prison sentences of less than 12 months criminals convicted of offences, so that they do not apply to crimes such as stalking, harassment and revenge porn., Women and girls could be put at risk if those convicted of crimes such as harassment, stalking, and revenge porn are punished in the community rather than sent to prison. We agree with arguments that shorter sentences reflect a lack of understanding about the harmful impact of domestic abuse. To introduce a presumption in law against shorter prison sentences could put the lives of women and girls at risk and serve as a lesser deterrent to perpetrators.

Fast track benefits as soon as someone is diagnosed as terminally ill, Being told you have a terminal illness is devastating news. Being told you're not eligible for fast track benefits because you're expected to live longer than the '12 months or less' timeframe feels inhumane. TERMINAL MEANS TERMINAL, even if you're likely to live longer than 12 months. , Our Prime Minister stated in the Commons he would look after the most vulnerable in society but fast track is only offered to those that are expected to die within 12 months. I myself am terminally ill and have been through the cruel benefits assessment. I ASK YOU TO SIGN THE PETITION CALLING ON THE GOVERNMENT TO CHANGE WHAT WE BELIEVE IS AN INHUMANE RULING AS THIS AFFECTS MANY TERMINALLY ILL PEOPLE. The Government says it's compassionate but we believe the restrictions on dying people are the opposite of compassionate.

Reinstate the death penalty for child sexual offences, We believe current punishments for child sexual offences are too weak and don't reflect the impact of these crimes. We want capital punishment to be reinstated. The children of the UK deserve to be safe and we believe people convicted of child sexual offences don't deserve to live.,

Stop the Rwanda plan and protect the rights of people seeking asylum in the UK, The Government’s plans to ship people seeking asylum to Rwanda were always cruel and immoral. Now that the Supreme Court has found the scheme to be unlawful, the Government must immediately abandon the deal and any other similar plans, The Rwanda plan is an attack on the principle of refugee protection in the UK. The Government must uphold its legal and moral responsibility to people in need of protection. We also urge the Government to end and refrain from any other deals to send people to third countries or have their asylum claims processed offshore. We call on the Government to protect the universal right to seek asylum, and uphold everyone’s human rights regardless of where they are from or how they came to this country.

No Pride in Deportation: Stop the Deportation of LGBTIQ+ People Seeking Asylum, End the harmful practice of deporting or otherwise removing LGBTIQ+ people seeking asylum in the UK, seeking alternative solutions that do not put people at risk of harm. 

No-one who is an LGBTIQ+ person should be sent to Rwanda or another third country, or deported., Deportation can inflict severe psychological trauma and increase the risk of harm to people seeking asylum. Deportation holds an even greater risk for LGBTIQ+ people seeking asylum, as such individuals often flee their home countries to escape persecution and violence due to their sexual orientation or gender identity. Deporting them back to these hostile environments can risk condemning them to continued suffering, exile, physical harm, emotional trauma, abuse, isolation, torture and death.

Restrict the use of drones by police for the purpose of surveillance, In accordance with Article 8 of the European Convention on Human Rights, police should not intrude on the private lives of our people via drone technology unless there is an active crime or serious suspicion of threat to democracy., Unless there is an active crime or serious suspicion of threat to democracy, we believe the interference with the right to privacy cannot be justified on legal grounds, and that drones should not be used for surveillance under any other circumstances.

UK must not leave the ECHR, or opt-out of/ignore any of its rights, We believe the UK should not, in any circumstances, leave the European Convention on Human Rights (ECHR), or opt out of, or ignore, any of the rights contained within it. We believe it must rescind any policies or Acts of Parliament that contravene the Convention., We believe that the UK government is seeking to breach the ECHR through its Rwanda deportation scheme.

Stop classing student maintenance loan as income when working out UC entitlement, The Government needs to stop classing student maintenance loan as income when determining entitlement to Universal Credit., The DWP deduct exactly the amount of student maintenance loan from UC entitlement. I think this is WRONG! The maintenance loan has to be paid back from future income so SHOULD NOT be classed as income! I think having it deducted from benefit entitlement is basically like having to pay it back twice!

Review the role of juries in sexual offence trials, A review could include evaluating whether only certain jurors should serve on these cases, based on their knowledge and any biases, and whether they should have to undergo training before a trial., Sexual offence cases are complex when it comes to the law, stereotypes, biases and taboos. We believe Jurors are not always equipped.
 
The rape conviction rate in the UK is extremely low, reported last year to be just 1%, and we believe the current system does not work.
 
Many victims of sexual offences do not come forward due to the fact that there is rarely a conviction and they are concerned about how they will be treated by the justice system.
 
Juries may not be able to comprehend the complexity of these cases without training. There are also taboos associated with some sexual offences cases, and we believe the justice system works in the suspect's favour. This can mean that people who might have been guilty of an offence are acquitted due to a jury’s misunderstanding or bias.

Make spiking an indictable offence with minimum of 3 months prison and area bans, Spiking should be an indictable offence with a minimum sentence of 3 months, which increases with repeat offending. Area banning orders should also be used. This could help root out repeat offenders and keep our nightlife as safe as possible. , There are many reports on the news about individuals being spiked within the night-time economy. Making spiking an indictable offence could help deter people from doing it and increase the number of people who report it to the police.

Make domestic abuse training mandatory for all social workers, Recently, at a conference where I shared my lived experience of domestic abuse with 300 social workers, even though many of their clients are victims of domestic abuse, they do not have mandatory training in place. I want all social workers to have mandatory domestic abuse training., By implementing mandatory training for all social workers we can ensure they are equipped with the knowledge and skills necessary to recognise the signs of domestic abuse, provide appropriate support and connect survivors with the resources they need to break free from abusive situations. With mandatory training in place, we can empower social workers to better understand the dynamics of abuse and provide survivors with the compassion and effective support they deserve.

Ban the naming of suspects/defendants before conviction, We want the police, courts and media to be banned from naming suspects and defendants until they are convicted. What happened to innocent until proven guilty? We believe the naming of suspects and defendants can prejudice cases., It should be made illegal to name suspects prior to conviction. Suspects have a right to a fair trial, and we believe suspects and defendants should not have to put up with public discussion of their guilt or innocence. This should solely be a matter for the courts. Naming of suspects and defendants can also affect their families.
